about.heading: From the law to the grooming table.
paragraphs: I set up Keith's K9 Care, a professional dog grooming service in Wakefield, after spending more than 30 years working as a solicitor - making the decision to swap the courtroom for the dog spa and work with dogs full-time.

My love of dogs began with the arrival of our golden retriever, Ringo, during lockdown. What started as a new addition quickly grew into something much bigger, and it wasn't long before Ringo was joined by Rolo, whose lively and playful personality is the perfect contrast to Ringo's calm and gentle nature.

Today, I provide a calm, one-to-one dog grooming experience in Wakefield from my purpose-built home dog spa. Every dog I care for has my full attention, with no other animals present during appointments, creating a relaxed, safe and stress-free environment - ideal for nervous or anxious dogs.

services.heading: What we do - gently, properly, and at your dog's pace.
services.description: Cockapoos, doodles, terriers, retrievers, small breeds, large breeds- every coat type welcome. From puppy first grooms to senior tidies and hand-stripping.

pricingTeaser.heading: Clear pricing, no surprises.
pricingTeaser.description: I'm proud to publish my prices upfront. Competitive rates, no hidden fees, and I always confirm the final price before we start.

salon.heading: A purpose-built salon in the heart of Hall Green.
salon.description: A home salon in a converted garage, with no kennels and no other dogs barking through the wall. Fully equipped, calm and set up around your dog's comfort.
